title: Mitosis architecture audit and rebuild exploration

completion_criteria.text: Foundational audit of the current engine complete across all four domains: two-layer fan-out, durability/resume, cost/latency, pipeline rigidity + fragility
External research verdict delivered on whether the architecture is correct, with disconfirming pass and cited prior art
The child_process runtime-capability question settled empirically (does dynamic import of node:child_process EXECUTE inside a Workflow script, not merely resolve)

Three open architecture decisions resolved by the user: adopt an off-the-shelf durable-execution runtime vs only its state model; default speculation depth given that rework costs tokens not machine time; which work-type pipelines to define first
An approved architecture spec for the rebuild exists, superseding or explicitly scoping the six paused repair-oriented mitosis threads

spine.active_goal: MSP M6 (durable run-identity manifest, spec 3.5) is SHIPPED and open as PR #28 on feat/m6-durable-run-identity - commits abde750/1ba18e1/174a0dc/e516fc9, suite 1846/1846 confirmed first-hand, guard 46/46, coverage gate ok. A2 is KILLED (0175), closing Gap 1's extraction inventory. All three M6 preconditions cleared. Four spec-3.5 deviations ratified and implemented (0176/0177/0178/0179); spec 3.5 carries an As-shipped amendment. PR #28 is NOT merged - merge stays human-gated.
spine.next_step: (1) Merge PR #28 when ready, then re-derive origin/main and confirm green. (2) M6 landing leaves M3 next in spec order, but M3 is BLOCKED on the A3 characterization test (0162): M3 deletes runReconcileOnlyAdvance (0161), so starting without A3's test deletes unpinned behaviour. Write A3's characterization test FIRST, on its own branch off a merged main. (3) Then M3. Do NOT start M3 before A3.
open_risks: A3 and A5 characterization tests are still owed before M3 and M5 (0162). SEPARATE from Gap 1's extraction inventory, which 0175 closed. M3 deletes runReconcileOnlyAdvance, so A3 must land first or unpinned behaviour is deleted.

M4 moved to THREATENED by 174a0dc: three behavior changes plus the structural publishedSpecPath share one commit range, and three characterization tests were rewritten in it. 1840 prior tests stayed green - after-the-fact evidence, not before-the-fact characterization.

A reconcile-only relaunch returns before the publish stage (~mitosis.js:4173) so it does NOT retry a lost publish; a full advance does. Reaching it needs the publish block hoisted into a function, adjacent to out-of-scope constraints. Named in SKILL.md and the spec amendment.
computeLogicalRunId still hashes only spec path + baseBranch (0176), so a superseded manifest ref is never reaped. Accepted and recorded, not silently carried.
published.sourcePrefix is logged on disagreement but does not WIN (0179). A relaunch under a different prefix will not recognise already-merged integration branches and can re-ship shipped work.
Inertness mutations were NOT run for 174a0dc's four changes, so M3's coverage verdict is threatened rather than clean. invariant-coverage-check pull_request mode can now be run, since PR #28 exists.
PR scope is FROZEN at creation; title/body edits are denied, later facts go in a comment (0142). pr-create rejected angle brackets in a --what value as an HTML tag opener - reword, never force.
NEVER invoke the compiled workflow. compileWorkflow returns a frozen async callable that would dispatch REAL agents. mitosis.js is read and edited as TEXT only.
Runner is `npm test` (package.json:7), ~7s; `node --test <dir>` fails MODULE_NOT_FOUND, `node --test <file>` works. .githooks/pre-commit runs the full suite on every commit but NOT on cherry-pick.
A red result from a hand-rolled shell one-liner is suspect BEFORE the code is - re-run it in node. This produced false byte-identity failures in BOTH the verify and re-verify phases this session.

Landing stays SERIAL for mitosis.js and the mirror census; a policed-twin edit lands in BOTH copies in one commit. The fix round broke this once editing fatalReport (an outcome.mjs twin); the guard caught it. Parallelize investigation, never landing.

ORCHESTRATION: cut the branch in the main thread BEFORE dispatching; never pair a branch-switching agent with one reading the working tree. Writes under .claude/{hooks,rules,lib,workflows} need per-write human approval.

Five pre-existing dirty paths persist (.claude/settings.json, .zshrc, two .bak files, .claude/skills/context7-mcp/) - stage explicit paths only, NEVER git add -A. 17 worktree entries remain live; the reaper verb still does not exist.

Spec/plan line anchors remain stale wholesale (0148 rejected a standalone rewrite). Spec 3.5's identifier and clause text are now correct via the amendment, but its line anchors and the m2-mirror-gaps plan's are not re-baselined.
out_of_scope: Any change at mitosis.js:4058-4061. H-C is REFUTED by 0159, not deferred - the done-union is correct and narrowing it is a liveness regression. Re-opening needs new evidence of an unconfirmed-ship producer.
Removing or weakening the veto at mitosis.js:3787. It is the resurrection guard (0160); frontier-train-e2e.test.mjs:578 forbids it. M2 names and logs it, nothing more.
Un-ignoring docs/superpowers/plans/ wholesale, and git add -f as the tracking mechanism - both rejected by 0158 in favour of the /* plus negation form.
Track A / continuity-ledger-plugin until all mitosis MSPs are delivered (0136). A-1, A-2, A-3 and the Track A half of Wave 0 are DEFERRED, not abandoned.
Any further B-6 work. Implemented, merged and green; the invariant is discharged. Re-opening needs a new reason, not a re-read.
Rewriting the specs' 78 anchors as a standalone effort - rejected by 0148. Re-baseline by execution per MSP instead.
Executing run-readiness-repair's MSP-0..MSP-10. Quiescent-advance M0..M8 lands first, and the overlap (M0/M1 against MSP-6/MSP-7) must be reconciled before that spec is scheduled.
Pipelines for refactor, perf, docs or chore - closed by 0118. Limits PIPELINES only, not the PR title type vocabulary.
The feat pipeline - 0110 sequences it second, after the fix pipeline proves the effector boundary.
Speculation depth above 1 - 0109 requires a restack proven for the fix work type first.
Bootstrapping a target repo's test infrastructure as a side effect of shipping - closed by 0117; that is verify-setup, human-invoked.
Adopting an off-the-shelf durable-execution runtime - closed by 0108. A webhook, server or daemon for the relaunch trigger - closed by 0119.
fileScope-only task-edge derivation - rejected by 0116, settled by 0120.
Cluster-aware scheduling and the journal's 2000-char model-output paging - fenced out by spec section 1.
Dispatching or restarting any target-repo mitosis run.
Opening a pull request for docs/mitosis-core-rebuild-spec - the user ruled on 2026-07-30 that leaving it without a PR is fine.
